args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living vs. Covey & Lark
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on a label mix-up around PHL:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", so it points to the old name.
- Coverage notes are picking up the old label, which makes the search return the wrong account.

Could you help make sure the saved report and any related records are relabelled to Pellow Home Living? Happy to go through the details with you.

Thanks,
Sofia

args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A cleanup note on the PHL label mix-up. Two businesses share the PHL shorthand, so please use full names:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", which points to the old name. It needs relabelling to Pellow Home Living.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows (Pellucid Harbor Logistics), not Pellow.

Could you help get the saved report relabelled and check that PHL filters return the right account? Happy to go through it with you.

Thanks,
Bettina
